features.name: Rallying Cry
features.desc: When you use Second Wind, you choose up to three allies within 60 feet: each one that can see and hear you regains Hit Points equal to your Fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.desc: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill (or another skill of your choice if you already have it), and your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for Persuasion checks.

features.name: Inspiring Surge
features.desc: When you use Action Surge, you let an ally within 60 feet use its Reaction to make a weapon attack. From level 18, two allies.

features.name: Bulwark
features.desc: When you use Indomitable to reroll an Int, Wis, or Cha saving throw, you let an ally within 60 feet that failed the same saving throw reroll it too.
